one_liner: Google Ads API is a free, broad API (REST/gRPC) with OAuth2; production use requires access-level approval per Cloud project, and an official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user authorization via a Google Cloud project is the standard method; service accounts are also supported. Developer tokens were sunset and access levels are now tied to the Cloud project.
access_notes: The API is free. Test access is immediate. Explorer access is mostly automated but capped at 2,880 operations per day. Basic and Standard access need review, and RMF audits may apply.
blocker_notes: Meaningful production use needs a higher access level (Basic or Standard) through Google's review. Test accounts and Explorer access can be used to build and test in the meantime.
